title: Harden Diagnostics WebView feedback and action gating
summary: Hardened the Diagnostics WebView tab with semantic panel statuses, inline row action feedback, stale-refresh markers, grouped allowlisted evidence access, explicit log/tail states, local owner-handoff confirmation, command/contract evidence cues, and a gated Tdarr proof/matrix action ladder.
reason: Diagnostics needed clearer evidence navigation, lifecycle/log feedback, and advanced-action safety while preserving backend authority and avoiding any frontend-owned media, lifecycle, cleanup, queue, settings, publish, rename, or filesystem mutation behavior.
behavior_before: Diagnostics status panels were text-only in several areas, generated Read/Open controls did not always show local per-button feedback, pipeline/launch/file log panels did not consistently distinguish empty, missing, unavailable, truncated, and read-error states, allowlisted file access was a flat action row, partial refresh failures could leave stale panels looking current, raw command evidence competed with structured drilldown, and Tdarr cleanup/delete controls did not present a complete visible prerequisite ladder.
behavior_after: Diagnostics panels now use shared status helpers with data-state and live-region semantics, generated Read/Open controls show in-place busy/success/cancel/error feedback, stale partial refreshes mark affected Diagnostics/State/Commands/Contract panels, log/tail panels expose explicit loaded/empty/missing/unavailable/truncated/read-error states, allowlisted targets are grouped with bounded Read Tail before Open where applicable, owner handoff confirms local-only navigation on destination pages, command/contract evidence leads with operator-first structured summaries, and Tdarr proof/matrix controls require evidence/proof/plan/archive/typed confirmation before delete can be requested through the backend-owned route.
tests_added: Extended tests/python/desktop/test_application_facade_web_static.py static pins for Diagnostics status helpers, table allowlist entries, grouped access controls, Tdarr delete confirmation, stale refresh wiring, explicit log/tail states, command detail ordering, contract safety copy, and local owner-handoff confirmation.

Extended tests/webview/test_webview_browser_diagnostics_handoff_smoke.py with fixture browser assertions for row-level inline feedback, duplicate suppression, grouped allowlisted access, stale refresh markers, log/tail state labels, command/contract evidence ordering, Tdarr gated ladder/cancel/backend rejection, and 375/768/1440 responsive overflow checks.
manual_validation: Broader tests/python/desktop/test_application_facade_web_static.py currently has unrelated Home/Launch static failures in the dirty worktree; this Diagnostics change did not expand into those areas.
Fixture Local API lifecycle contract smoke passed: ops/scripts/smoke/Test-LocalApiLifecycleContractSmoke.ps1.
Scoped git diff --check for the Diagnostics files passed; Git reported existing LF-to-CRLF working-copy warnings only.
node --check on changed WebView JavaScript assets passed.
python -m py_compile on changed Diagnostics smoke/static test files passed.
rollback_plan: Revert the Diagnostics WebView asset changes, page-diagnostics markup changes, the focused static pins, the Diagnostics browser smoke extensions, and this change packet. No backend route/schema/state/media behavior was changed.
notes: Frontend-only implementation. Tdarr proof/delete browser coverage uses mocked apiGet/apiPost responses inside the fixture browser; no real Tdarr cleanup/delete/media route is invoked. Required smoke wrappers ran only against temporary fixture backends.
